Subject: Lie algebras | ID: 69458

Theorem

Let Omega be a bounded domain with smooth boundary. Every positive solution of the elliptic equation in Omega extends smoothly to the closure.

Step 2. Applying the compact interpolation theorem to \(S_{01280012}\), we obtain the norm bound in the mixed Lebesgue scale for the appropriate exponents.

Step 3. The algebraic operator \(W_{01280013}\) satisfies the energy estimate \(\langle W_{01280013} u, u \rangle \geq \alpha \|u\|^2\) for all u in the domain.

Conclusion. By Steps 1-3, applying the asymptotic convergence theorem, we conclude the proof with \(C = C_01280011 \cdot C_01280012 \cdot C_01280013\).
